info.name: Employee Console API
info.description:
Employee Console API (NestJS) — positive and negative contract tests (PRD USR-04, AC-53).

Run: `pnpm test:postman` creates an isolated test database, starts the API with APP_ENV=test and runs this collection with Newman.

Environment variables (templates in tests/postman/*.postman_environment.json):
- `baseUrl` — origin serving /api (API port directly, or the Next.js app which proxies /api).

Requests run in order and expect a freshly seeded database (5 employees, ids 101–105; next id 106). Runtime values are kept in collection variables.
